newsitem.title: USA: Two scientists join Endorex unit's board.
newsitem.headline: Two scientists join Endorex unit's board.

text.p: Endorex Corp said Thursday Robert Langer of the Massachusetts Institute of Technology and Henry Brem of Johns Hopkins University joined the Scientific Advisory Board of its Orasomal Technologies unit.
Langer specializes in chemical and biomedical engineering, while Brem is a professor of neurology, Endorex said.
The company said the board would help identify areas for drug development that best utilize Orasomal's oral vaccine, allergen and drug delivery technology.
